My dear [Miss Smith](/person/263)
I am much entertained by your Scarborough paper as I remember those Rivaulx terraces some 25 years ago, the only place where my sights coincide with yours.[^2] I only wish I saw more present prospect of room for it!

You must be one of my oldest contributors.

Did you not like Miss Sewell’s paper on family traditions

yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/ 1887/ 2 is a Silurian envelope addressed to Miss Carter Smith/ Aspley House/ Aspley Guise/ Woburn, postmarked Winchester (date and month cut out) 1887.
[^2]: The article has not been identified.
